tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po'i bya ba las kyi sne mor mngags pa rnams kyi bca' yig bzhugs so// swa sti/ 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel ba la/ /gzhan dang mtshungs pa med pa'i bka' drin can/ /sngags 'chang mchog dang a mes zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas nas 'jig rten gyi khams su dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'chi med 'khon gyi gdung brgyud bla chen dkon mchog rgyal pos dpal sa skya'i dgon gnas khyad par can 'di thog mar bzhengs/ rigs sras bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi bdag po pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i byang phyogs kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa de nyid kyi dbon chos rje khu dbon gyi sku drin la 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa zhes grags shing mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i gdan sa khyad par can 'di nyid du/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i gsal byed sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs sogs dam pa gong ma de dag gi rigs dbon gyi tha shal ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bdag 'dra tsandan sdong po'i shul du yor mo mgo zing skyes pas rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa nyams pa'i snga ltas yin pa gdon mi za yang / gong ma de dag gi zhabs nas mi 'dren cing / gdan sa'i lugs gnyis kyi khrims mgo med mjug med du mi 'gro ba'i phyir rang gcig pus gdan sa chen po'i khur ma thag pa rnams la sngon gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis chos srid phyag las so so la mgo yod re bsko bzhag mdzad 'dug pa rnams nas gdan sa chen por phan slebs che ba'i bgyi ba mtha' dag 'chug med dgos tshul brda sprod brjed tho'i tshul du zhu na/ chos grwa lho byang gi mkhan rin po che rim can rnams la las tshan ma mdzad gong sku yon sogs gang cir rnam dpyod yod gras nas brtag sgril la bzang thon bsko bzhag zhus don ltar/

gtso bor mdo sngags rig gnas gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i sbyong brdar mdzad ngos/ theg dman theg chen rdo rje theg pa dang bcas pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing mchog tu 'gyur ba zhig dang / chos grwa lho byang gi sgrig lam kun spyod tshang ma bca' yig rim can sor bzhag spyi pa/ dbu chos/ las thog pa/ gling dpon so so la legs slob nyes bcos kyi bkod khyab rim can dang / de mtshungs brgya dpon/ chos las pa/ ban gtsang pa'i dbu byed/ mchod dpon/ bsnyen song dbu chos las thog pa rnams la'ang bde chen gling bca' yig bzhin byed dgos tshul yang bka' khyab che ngos/ chos grwa lho byang gi sgrig lam kun spyod tshang ma rje btsun gong ma'i dgongs bzhed dang mthun par 'phel rgyas yong ba'i thugs bsam che bskyed gnang dgos la/ mchog gsum dang las 'bras khyad gsod lugs gnyis khrims kyog tu ma song ba zhig dgongs 'jags zhu/ ༈ snga thog chos rje khu dbon gyi skabs las tshan bcu gsum bsko bzhag mdzad pa'i thog ma gsol dpon nas yin kyang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi sku thog tsam nas bzung phyag gnyer gnyis las tshan thams cad kyi gtso 'dzin du 'jog par mdzad cing / de'i nang nas kyang mdzod pa la/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis kyi sku thog nam mkha' bsam 'grub nas bzung gzhan las mthong bzos bdag rkyen che bar mdzad pa'i dgos pa zhal ngo gdung brgyud rnams chos 'chad nyan sogs gnang dgos pas/ gzhan la lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i bka' bkod zhi drag sogs khrims gcur yang yang gnang dgos byung na dam tshig gi nyes pa gsog pa'i rgyur 'gro bar dgongs nas mdzod pa yong nges 'os tho'i thog brtag sgril bzang thon de la thog mar bsko bzhag mdzad skabs sogs rim can du bstan don lar rgya'i babs yul tshang mar 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bka' bkod gnang / lag len che phra tshang ma mdzod pa des khur khur nas bgyis tshe nang don tshang zhing phyi'i blta yul mdzes pa zhig yong ba'i dgongs gzhi thun mong min par 'dug pas na/

mdzod pa rim can nas nges dgos/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che chud zos su ma song bar don yod pa gal che zhing / de yang rang rang gis las bsags pa'i grub mtha' dang yul sna tshogs kyi skal ba myang skabs so so'i lugs gnyis kyi khrims dang mi 'gal zhing de dag drang por srong thub pa zhig la las gnag rnam smin dkar ba/ 'phen byed sdig pas 'phangs kyang rdzogs byed dge bas rdzogs pa'i las zhes bya ba yin pas na ngo skal du gyur pa dpal sa skya'i bstan srid lar rgya 'di nyid kyi phyir lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs med du gtong nus pa'i snying stobs dang / bla ma gong ma gdung brgyud chos sde dang bcas pa'i zhabs tog dus khor mo yug tu sgrub nus pa'i brtson 'grus dang / gdan sa'i mnga' zhabs rnams dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag snying khongs su bcangs ngos/ gdung brgyud gong ma lugs gnyis gang sar mkhyen rlabs phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod na de'i bka' gang gnang gsung ci 'grub dang / sku gzhon nu'i dus sam gal te ha cang gi mkhyen rgya che ba zhig med na bstan don lar rgya la phan pa'i phyir 'phral phugs su bltas pa'i snyan sgron yang yang dang / de dang cha mtshungs rang gi sa nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi lar rgya la 'chug med sra thang gi byed sgo 'dzol med byed cing / de dag la'ang yus kyis snang ba dang / nga rgyal gyi dbang du song nas rang ma gtogs zhal ngo gdung brgyud rnams sa skya pa min pa lta bus dbang che she mang las 'bras khyad bsad de rigs gtan nas mi byed/ phan bde'i rtsa ba gdung brgyud kyi gzhi rten srid 'dzin khab len gyi skor yang rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing brtan brling khel ba kha shas brtag sgril gyi thog nas bzang thon de len pa dang chabs cig gang ci'i skor zhib cha byed/ mkhan rin po ches mtshon chos grwa lho byang gi las tshan rnams bsko bzhag byed skabs so so'i bca' yig gi don bzhin las tshan bya spu gnon mgo 'og lus khyur gyi sgrig lam kun spyod sra thang du skyong dgos tshul dang /

de dag gi rgyab skyor kha zhe med pa byed cing / sgrig 'gal sna tshogs byung tshe las tshan so sor nyes pa che chung la dpag pa'i 'jun thar yod tshul sogs legs slob nyes 'chos zhib gsed bgyis ngos/ rang gis shes pa'am gzhan drag zhan 'bring gsum sna tshogs la 'dri rtsad bgyis pa'i gong bkod kha ta bzhin ma byung na lan 'gal yar gyi bar la zhi drag gi bslab bya yang yang dang / des kyang ma 'thus na las tshan 'pho len byed pa'am/ khrims zhi drag gang rung gis gcur/ de bzhin du gnyer dpon gsol gzim sku gzhogs pa tshang ma dang / mgron gnyer gnyer tshang pa sogs drung 'khor tshang mar yang gdung brgyud dang bstan don lar rgya la bsam pa rgya gang che bgyis ngos/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i las gang yin pa de la 'chug med bstar chags kyi thog nas/ gzhan phyi nang gsang gsum gang du mngags kyang 'bras bu don smin las rjes ngo mtshar can lto dang gos sbyin mtho bar bzhag pa la rjes yod pa zhig dgos tshul dang / gnas skabs su'ang de dag la legs slob nyes 'chos 'thus ma shor ba bgyis kyang skyed ma thon pa byung na zhib tu brtag la de rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyis babs nas de ma gtogs mi thon pa zhig yin na las tshan brje 'phrul byed/ shes yon can 'dar yams su song ba sogs snang shes spra 'chal ma 'chun pa zhig yin na bslab bya zhib gsod bgyis tshe phyis nas go ba zhig yong 'gro snyam zhing / rang gi phugs rigs rgyang gsum mno bsam mthong ba sogs shes bzhin du mi byed par rdzu che ba'am/ bsam pa skyon can gyis thams cad dkrugs pa'am/ shes yon gi nga rgyal nas rang gis khrims drang bsrangs kyang de dag la mi brtsi byed sgo sna tshogs byung na/ spyir chos 'jig rten gyi rgyu 'bras bslab bya dang / bye brag rang gi sa nas dkon mchog dpang bzhag gi bya ba byas pa yin kyang de la mi brtsi ba'i rgyu mtshan rang sa na nyes pa yod tshe snga phyi bar gsum shig mdzub sprad pa'i dag ther dgos tshul dang /

de ltar min na bstan don lar rgya tshang mar las tshan gyi bkod pa bgyis pa bzhin nyan na khe che ba yong zhing / des kyang ma 'thus tshe dkar nag bden brdzun gyi dbye 'byed 'phral du yong tshul sogs gleng la don gyi lag len kyang bkal/ rang gi sa nas dkon mchog gsum dang shes ldan gzur gnas rnams mi khrel zhing / zhi drag gi khrims gang la thug kyang g.yo sgyu zol zog gis thon mi dgos par rang bzhin gyi nyes med dkar sing du thon yong ba zhig bya/ de bzhin du bla ma gong ma'i tshul sgrub mchod dkar me dus ja ste bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thabs stod smad bar gsum gyi 'bul sdud bla rigs tshong khag mi ser mnga' zhabs bcas la bkod pa byed tshul ni/ 'bul sdud pa rnams la bstan don lar rgya bsam pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag ngos so so'i dgon sde sbyin bdag sger pa skyong dgos tshang mar lugs gnyis kyi khrims gzhung drang por bsrangs ba'i babs nas/ chos 'chad nyan/ gson po'i yar 'dren/ gshin po'i rjes 'jug dgon sde dang chab 'bangs skyong dgos thams cad la legs slob nyes 'chos bstan don lar rgya rang gzhan la 'di phyir dge ba kun 'thud ma shor bar rtag 'grus su bgyis ngos/ sgar dgon sbyin bdag chos gzhis sogs rang rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa thams cad yar bskyed phun tshogs yod thog nas shi gson gyi dngos po ji snyed byung ba thams cad chud mi za ba'i phyir gdan sa gzhung 'di nyid du yongs rdzogs btab pa'i lhag ma nas sger pa drag zhan tshang mar ngo 'dzin byed dgos rnams gzhung gnod med pa zhig byed cing / de dag gi mthun rkyen gyi gtso bo bla grwa rnams bslab pa gtsang zhing gnyer lag do dpon g.yog tshang ma mthun grub kyi thog nas sgar chas rta drel mdzo g.yag sogs cha rkyen thams cad la chud zos med cing bcag dag rang gzhan dang ba 'gro ba zhig dgos tshul dang bla grwa dpon g.yog sogs mi mthun pa byung na thog mar bla gnyer gnyis nas gcig gis gcig la legs slob nyes 'chos mthun grub byed pa'am/

bla ma mkhyen rlabs che na gnyer par bkod khyab dang / gnyer pa shes sgo yangs thang che na bla mar snyan sgron zhabs 'gyur ngos/ grwa pa lag do rnams la nye 'gyang med pa'i zas dang rkang gos sogs sbyin/ las kyi rim pa'ang cha snyoms nas byed bcug la gang dang ma mthun pa de dang de la skyon sel gyi kha ta byed/ spyod rtsing bag med rnams la 'jur thag sogs kyis gcun/ gal te de dag gis kyang ma 'thus tshe 'di gar snga phyi bar gsum gyi rgyu mtshan zhib cha dgos tshul dang / gdan sa'i lar rgya gdung brgyud dang chos sde'i zhabs 'degs la bsam byes 'gro ba tshang mas lus spyod pa dul zhing ngag btsun pa dang / yid la rnam rtog ngan pa bsrung gang thub ngos/ sa phyogs gang du phyin kyang bzang zhing legs pa'i dpe la sa skya'i sgar pa dpon slob lta bu dgos zhes gzhan gyi bstod bkur bsngags gsum byed thub pa zhig dang / sgar chas tshang ma 'bul ba'i rigs mtha' dag la brnab sems dang ma byin len spangs pa'i gzhung bsam gang che dgos tshul gyi bslab bya dang / stod smad bar gsum gyi tshong pa rnams la gdan sa chen po'i phyag rdzas tshong spus bsgyur du gnang ba 'di thams cad sbyin bdag dad can shi gson rnams nas bla ma gong ma gdung brgyud dang bcas pa la dad gus kyi sgo nas phul ba 'di dag rnam dkar dge rgyun gyi thabs su spus bsgyur nas smin par byed rgyu la/ phyag rdzas stobs chen 'di dag chud mi za zhing gdan sa chen po'i dge thabs rgya che spom mtho 'byung ba'i phyir dus gnas dang bstun pa'i gong thang che chung zog gang la gang 'gro sogs tshang ma zhib cha bgyis pa'i/ stod smad bar gsum nas rang rang gi ngo skal gyi tshong spus bsgyur tshang ma zhe thag bgyis ngos/ gdan sa chen por phyag 'byor gang che yong ba'i do dam hur bskyed bdag don bdag gces dang / gdan sa'i phyag rdzas rnams la rang dbang bdag 'dus kyis bag med longs spyod lag mi gtsang ba'i cha nas sba bsri rkung bsubs tshong lugs mthun ma byas pa'i khrol brlag tu song ba dang /

lugs mthun byas kyang gzhung slebs med pa sogs byung na do dam phyi lam kheg pa yong tshul dang / de dag gi yo byad rta drel g.yag sogs khal 'gros tshang ma dang sgar chas yongs rdzogs la bcag dag rus thon dgos tshul tshong gnyer lag do rnams mthun grub bgyis ngos/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa bag med du ma song ba'i sgar pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa zhig dang / tshong gnyer rnams kyis lag do byings la bslab bya byas don bzhin tshang mas 'khur dgos pa sogs legs slob nyes 'chos mtha' dag yang yang byas la/ 'bul sdud pa rnams dang / tshong pa rnams kyis byes su legs nyes ji ltar byas tshul rang bzhin gyis mi rgyus can rnams la dri rtogs kyis nya mgo gang non byas ngos 'thus min yod tshe de rnams la 'jur dag zhi drag gang rung gis khrims med du ma song bar byed/ de bzhin du mnga' zhabs byings la'ang gzhis gnyer so so/ rgan bcu dpon sogs mgo yod tshang mar gdan sa chen po'i zhabs phyi sgrub pa'i mnga' zhabs rnams la skyong brdar byed tshul/ gdan sa nas dus dang dmigs bsal gyi khral rigs so nam zhing g.yog sogs skul dgos rnams gdan sa chen po'i bka' bzhin bsgrubs phyin don med du rang don ma 'grub pa'am dkar skyong nag 'ded phyogs cha nye ring lta bus mi ser la sbyong spyod sna tshogs dang / lag gis dngos po rnams bag med du len gang thub dang / gzhung dang mi ser gyi sa cha rang gis yug gcig tu 'debs pa dang / nya rgya ri rgya sogs la do dam mi byed par/ de dag gi gtso bo lta bus ri dwags kyi pags khral/ rus pa/ sha sogs mkho che ba rnams ngan slong dang mi ser gyi lag nas thabs mkhas kyis len pa dang / khyad par chos sde dang 'brel chags gnyer pa ser mo ba'i rigs 'gro khungs rnams su chang bag med du 'thung zhing / glu len pa/ mda' 'phen pa/ rta rgyug byed pa sogs chos sde'i sgrig dang 'gal bar byas pa dang /

dbyar khrims dgun khrims sogs lung pa de rang na sngar srol bzang po gang yod dang mi mthun pa byas pa shar tshe rtsa ra brda 'ded kyis rjes gnon yong tshul dang / gzhung don bsdu khral gyi rigs/ sa cha'i 'dul skyong rnams 'thus ma shor ba dang / rdzong mgo so so sogs mi chen rnams kyi sku mdun du bcar skabs rang phyogs kyi gtan tshigs ngag rgyun mthong brgyud thos brgyud rnams la zhib cha nges 'grongs kyi zhu don 'dzem chags can tshig ngar du ma song ba'i zhu ba khungs 'grongs dang / des kyang ma 'thus tshe gtan tshigs sogs spyan brdar zhu ba dang bstun rang phyogs dang mtshungs pa gzhan la rgyas 'gebs yod tshe de dag kyang lung du drangs pa'i zhu ba nan chen bgyid rgyur mi ser sogs kyi lag nas byung ba'i dngos po rnams phangs med du gtang ba'i khra bzung dang / des kyang ma 'thus na 'di nas rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs gang yin pa de zhabs su zhu don bgyid rgyu yin tshul sogs zhib cha dang / mi ser rnams la'ang rang rang gi khang gzhis sa rten rnams 'dul skyong snying thag pa nas byas ngos bud stongs sogs khungs rnyed tshe khungs 'jug dang / mi lag rags shing stobs kyis 'chun pa rnams la stod smad du tshong sogs la phyin ngos grong yar rgyas yod pa dang / pha ma bu tsha sogs nang tshang tshang ma mthun zhing bkra shis pa dang / mi mthun pa rnams la 'dum dkar gzu sogs kha tas khyab pa dang / mgon med nyams chung rnams la mgo 'don gang drag dang / rang bzhin gyi sa nas/ brku brdzun/ chom po/ zas min/ mthu gtad/ rtsod pa longs pa sogs byung na de dang de'i khrims rjes mthun gyi bden shan drang por bsrangs ba dang / ma 'thus pa ngan pa tshabs can rnams la 'di gar rgyu mtshan byas thog nas gdan sa chen po'i chos gzhis rnams la nyes bral yar rgyas yong ba zhig dgos tshul dang / gzhung don blos btang gi rang kho na za sgor thon pa lta bu'i rjes ngan byung na khrims kyis tshar gcod bya dgos pas de ltar du ma song ba zhig go dgos zhes bslab bya byas rting slad mar de don la ma gnas na dkar nag shan 'byed khrims gzhung drang po lag 'gel byed cing /

yang gtsug lag khang gi sku gnyer/ gad pa khang gnyer/ sgrub sde gong 'og bsam gling rin sgang sogs na yod pa'i do dam las byed pa rnams la de dag gi gtso bo khang dpon dang / las byed so so la gtsug lag khang gi zhabs tog byed tshul bde gling bca' yig na gsal ba de bzhin dang / lha khang chen mo dang / bzhi thog pho brang / phun tshogs gling gi thog drangs khang mig so so la zhabs tog byed pa'i gad pa khang gnyer tshang ma nas/ steng gi thugs rgyal mtshan/ spen bad/ spang bad/ wa kha thigs tshags tshang mar nyams gso gang dgos rus thon bcag dag dang / bar gyi khang mig so so'i gad logs zhal rtsi tshon/ rab gsal skar khung rnams kyi nag mthong / lhags skyor/ char khebs sogs gang dgos de dang de la 'gad gtsang yong ba dang / 'og gi sgo skras/ gsang spyod/ lam gzhung la phyags ma dgos pa/ mi khyi sogs srog chags bsrung ba/ dngos po btsog can bsdu ba sogs mdor na gtsug lag khang dang pho brang mi mdzes pa mtha' dag bsrung zhing bcag dag byas pa'i rtags su khang rnying lo mang can yin kyang bzo bsam zhing rang gzhan bzhugs spro ba/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag nas byin rlabs mi yal ba zhig dgos rgyur khang dpon gyis yang yang lta rtogs dang gzhan rnams kyis mthun rkyen gang la gang dgos bskul ba la de'i bdag rkyen gzhung nas kha zhe med par byas ngos/ gal te de dag gi gong tshig la mi gnas pa shar tshe kha ta tsha drag can nam chad pa snang che chung gang rigs 'gel ba dang / las tshan spo ba sogs skabs su babs pa'i do dam gang che dang / tshul bzhin du sgrub pa rnams la mgo 'don rgyab skyor nye 'gyangs med par gal che/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan sogs sa lugs dbus gtsang gi dgon khag rnams su bla ma bsko bzhag byed skabs bkod yig der dgon gyi sgrig lam kun spyod tshang ma so so'i bca' yig bzhin byas ngos/ mdo sngags gang yin gyi grwa de sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i bka' srol dang mthun par dar zhing rgyas pa dang /

dgon par nyams chag mi 'byung ba sogs grwa tshang gi spyi byus tshang ma la lhag bsam rgya gang che byed dgos tshul 'bri ba dang / ngos 'phrad byung tshe dngos su'ang de bzhin gleng / de bzhin du gdan sa chen po 'dir rang phyogs kyi bla ma mkhas grub rnams kyis thog drangs ris med dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed cig byon pa dang / sa skyong sde dge sku zhabs kyis thog drangs sbyin pa'i bdag po che phra chung gsum ji snyed cig byon pa de dag thams cad la'ang so so'i sku gnang che chung dang / lhag par gdan sa chen po 'di nyid dang 'brel chags tshul ji ltar yod zhib 'jug ngos/ skabs thob dang bstun pa'i bdag rkyen go 'dzol du ma song ba zhig dang / mchog dman gang yin yang sgo mgron gnyis kyis 'phral du sne sbyor byas don bzhin la rang rang gi blo mthun bzhin mjal 'phrad dang 'byor len sogs sgugs mi dgos par 'phral du thon pa zhig dang / dus mdos sogs phyogs mi shin tu bungs chen skabs de dag phan tshun lab zer du mi 'gro ba'i do dam khrims pa rnams la brjid non gang che dang / phur sgrub chen mo'i ltad mo ba/ dgongs rdzogs khag gi ser 'du rnams la'ang zing bshig med cing 'jam dar gyis rang gzhan bsam pa rdzogs pa zhig dang / lhag par ser 'du rnams kyi skabs chos grwa lho byang nas bzung ser mo ba tshang mar gser dngos gtong rgyu yod na de bzhin dang / med tshe ṭaṃ dus gnas kyis rgyugs pher na gser do dang / grwa pa ma yin pa'i rtogs ldan btsun ma sogs ser mo ba byings la rin po che de dag gis ma 'phrul na gser dod du ja'am dar de'i dod pher nges re/ skye bo byings rnams la thub na sngar srol la med pa'i skye bo sbyin gtong sne gtogs zhig gsar 'phar du gtong ba'am/ de min ngan slong sogs 'khrugs zing gi rgyu dang / byung ba rnams la yang yang ma byung ba rnams la gtan nas med pa sogs shin tu mi snyom pas sngar srol bzhin ser 'du kho na la thag bcad na 'gad gtsang bas de bzhin dang /

bla ma gong ma'i tshul sgrub mchod dkar me dus ja rgyun gyi zhal ja/ skyogs 'gyed/ phyogs dgon gyi mang bkol/ sbyin bdag rnams kyi thum bu rten bcas kyi slog 'ul lag gi mang ja skor zhal/ mi ser gyi dkar skyin/ nye 'khor gyi spus bsgyur gtong dgos sogs tshang mar gdan sa chen po 'di nyid la thas ngan mi yong zhing zhabs 'gyur gang che yong ba'i lhag bsam rnam dag dkon mchog thugs zhe mi khrel ba zhig dang / che btsun sku yul gnyen po rnams nas bzung sbyin bdag tha shal gyi bar du yig bskur byed dgos rnams la'ang rang rang gi 'byor lan zhib gsal dang / byin rten sogs bskur 'os rnams la so so'i 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i slog lugs dang / de min phyi nang gsang gsum gyi don rtsa tshang ma chal chol/ pha rol pos zhe khrel zhing / rang don mi 'grub pa'i gya tshom ma yin par gang yin de la khungs dag nges 'grongs re dang / gdan sa nas bka' shog rgyab snon ster ba'am bca' yig deb gzhi spyi 'gro sogs gang gtong yang 'phral phugs su slebs rgyang che ba zhig gdung brgyud rnams la zhu sbyor ram/ yang na rjes su gnang ba'i bka' lta bus bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab sngon ma la gzhi byas/ gnas skabs kun tu phan thogs pa'i tshig brling zhing don zab pa re 'dri lugs dang / mkhan rin po ches mtshon las tshan gang bkod kyang mi khungs chos 'jig rten gyi rnam dpyod yong thang sogs rang la rgyus yod pa'am/ gzhan mang po la go bsdur gyis yong nges re la zer zhing / lhag par zla bo nang ma'i rigs blo thub sems chung rgyu 'bras la brtsi 'jog byed pa zhig la nges par zer dgos de bzhin dang / gzhan yang gdan sa'i bstan don la rgyar dgos pa'i gtsug lag khang pho brang / sku gsung thugs rten/ grwa khang / mgron khang / tha mal pa'i khyim/ lcang rwa/ ru khag sogs gang sgrub dgos kyang brtan brling khel zhing 'phral yun kun tu bde chod pa gdan sa'i mdzes rgyan dam pa re ma gtogs dgos med rang gi snang ba la gang dran nam/

gzhan gyi ngo bltas rtsing 'chos mig ltos ngan pa'i rigs gtan nas mi byed cing / de dag gi gnas skabs su dgos pa'i bzo rigs pa tshang ma la'ang kho rang gi lag len 'gad gtsang min dang / zhag zla sogs ji tsam song gi gla yon ma pham tsam ster ba las/ 'ga' zhig la shin tu rgya che zhing 'ga' zhig la nyung ngu las med pa sogs mi snyoms pa'i rigs kyang gtan nas mi byed pa gal che bas sngar srol bzang po ltar nyi dros nas gsol ba yan dang / dgong ja nas bskyar zhus kyi bar phyag gzhung du bstan don lar rgya sgrub dgos tshang ma bstar chags su byed pa dang / phyag mdzod du mi dgos min kun thal byung du yong na rang gi de nyid ston zhing phyag rdzas rnams la sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sems can gyi sbar tshod byed pa lta bus phyi nang gsang gsum gang yin ngo mi shes pa'i chal chol du 'gro bas drung 'khor sogs dgos nges rnams ma gtogs gzhan tshang ma mgron gnyer brgyud cing dngos po sprod len sogs lde chung pa gnyis kyis byed pa ma gtogs lugs su bdes byas na gang dgos de dang de la stabs mi bde zhing thabs rdugs pa zhig yong 'dug pas slan chad bya ba gang la'ang yo yengs med pa dang / gdan sa 'di mchod yul gzhan dang ma 'dra bas khrims gnag rnams babs 'chol du mi byed cing / dpal sa skya'i bstan pa bshig pa/ zas min mthu gtad sogs ngan g.yo sna tshogs byed pa/ gdan sa gzhan dang gtsug lag khang gi sku chas gnang che ba rnams khyer ba sogs nag can lugs gnyis kyi khrims las 'das pa rnams la khrims yig zhal lce chen mo'i don bzhin byed/ srog skyob zhu mi sa phyogs ris gang nas byung yang gdan sa'i gzhung don la mi gnod cing skyob thub nges rnams la nges par mgo 'don byed pa dang / de min khrims bdag gang yin de la gsed bkrol zhu ngo bgyis kyang ma thub par nges par srog la babs pa zhig yod na/

de ma yin pa'i khrims zhig la dgongs pa e yong lta ba sogs bla ma gong ma'i mtshan don la phan gang thub byed cing / mdor na rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing rnam pa kun tu chud zos su ma song zhing / gdung brgyud rnams gnas skabs su thugs blo bde zhing bstan don la rgya chod che ba dang / mdzod pa rang gi sgrib byang tshogs rdzogs rang gzhan gyi 'di phyi'i don 'grub pa zhig go ba bskyed pa gal che/ ༈ de bzhin du gnyer dpon rim can nas/ gdan sa'i chos gzhis gnyer tshang du 'du dgos rnams la byams skyong gi mgo 'don byas ngos/ gzhung dang mi ser gyi sa cha'i 'dul skyong tshang ma bar ma lus par yar skyed yong ba'i do dam gang che byed pa dang / zhal ngo rnams gtso gyur thog de phyin mkhan phyag gnyer nas bzung rlon chas gang yin la nyin re tsam lcags gzar tshad ldan do re phogs pa rnams la da lta bzhin/ de mtshungs kyang mkhan phyag nas bzung sha thob gang yin la phyed 'dren sgang thob kyi byed spyod thog ci dgos tshang ma rang rang gi thob thang dang bstun pa'i grim lhod yo yang du ma song ba zhig dang / chos sde'i gtong sgo/ sbyin bdag gi kha 'dzin/ mi ser la dkar skyin gtong 'os tshang mar yang sngar srol bzang po bzhin mthong thos brgyud pa la yod pa rnams sra thang hur bskyed res 'jog tu ma song ba zhig dang / gdan sa gzhung la phan pa'i dkar rgya sogs 'jug gang thub dang / gtor ma dang chos rdzas dang yo byad tshang mar gtsang sbra gang che sogs mdor na gnyer khang gi byed sgo tshang ma sde bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba zhig dang / de don bzhin yong ba'i kha ta gnyer tshang pa nas bzung gzhis gnyer chung ngu'i bar du khyab par byas don bzhin la tshang mas thag pa khur blangs dang dpon g.yog tshang ma blo rtse gcig tu sgril ba'i gnyer tshang gzhung don kun 'chug med sra thang du yong ba gal che/ ༈ brgya dpon chos las pa/

ban gtsang dbu byed gsum/ mchod dpon pa/ spyi chen/ bskor dpon pa sogs stod smad kyi bla ma tshang mas nges dgos/ gdan sa chen po'i chos kyi bya ba tshul sgrub mchod gtor bzlog sogs gnas skabs kun tu dbyangs rol cho ga phyag len grwa tshang byings la slob dgos tshang ma brgya dpon dbu byed rnams kyis 'gan blangs/ nged rang gis brtsams pa'i bca' yig de nang bzhin sgrig lam kun spyod 'chug med yong ba'i do dam gang che dang / chos las pa gnyis nas kyang gzhis byes kyi bstan pa'i rnam gzhag pa rnams la gang ci'i skor legs slob nyes 'chos bshad pa sbyor gzhung tshang mar sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gi spyan ltos bzang po sogs ngo skal du gyur pa rnams 'chug med dang / spyi chen nas lho byang dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog phogs ja tshul rnams 'thud shor med pa'i yar bskyed dang / chos sde'i spyi rdzas la bdag rkyen gang drag ngos spyi mi byed dgos tshang ma go chod pa zhig dang / mchod dpon pa nas rdul tshon gtor bzo/ bris thig sogs lag len rnams grwa tshang la nges dag tu slob cing / mchod gtor rnams la gtsang sbra gang che rang gi byed cing gzhan la kha ta dang / mchod khang gi mchod chas tshang mar bdag rkyen do dam shin tu che ngos/ sgrig lam kun spyod 'chug med du skyong ba sogs byad dgos tshang mar do gal gang che dang / gzim chung bskor dpon pa sogs bla rigs rnams nas sbyin bdag dang dgon gnas skyong dgos rnams nyams chag tu mi 'gro zhing gdan sa'i 'bul sdud 'gro phan phyag 'byor stobs che ba dang / dpon g.yog mthun pa sogs bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs tshang ma hur bskyed gal che/ ༈ gsol gzim sogs sku gzhogs pa rnams nas nges dgos/ gsol dpon gyi lab kar rtse thab/ bar thab kyi chu len sogs kyis snod rnams dang / bkol 'du tshang ma gtsang sbra gang che/ lag len rus thon dgos tshul so sor tho zur gsal bzhin la rjes gnon do dam gang che dang /

bza' chas dang 'dren chas skor tshang mar bcag dag sogs ngo skal du gyur pa rnams 'chug med du yong ba dang / gzim dpon nas byed dgos nged rang sogs gdung brgyud rim can gyi gzim chung phyag rdzas nyer mkho rnams la bcag dag ngos gang la gang dgos nged rang gi blo mthun bzhin thogs med du yong ba dang / gzhan yang de dag gi gnas skabs su phyi nang gsang ba'i bya ba gang la'ang 'chug med sra thang ngos phyi rgya chod cing nang don tshang ba sogs/ mig nye med cing lag gtsang blo thub yong ba gal che/ drung yig nas byed dgos phyogs dang ris su ma phyed pa'i yi ge che phra tshang mar so so'i len 'tshem lus med cing don phigs pa zhig dgos rgyur yi ge rnams la zhib 'jug bgyis ngos/ phyag mdzod du de rtsis kyi rgyu mtshan mol thog nas lan byed lugs dang chos 'byung yig bskur gyi dpe dag yig sogs bstan bcos mkho che ba rnams la lta rtogs phul phyin bgyis ngos/ rtsom pa don bzang tshig brling dang / bsgrigs chags nor 'khrul med pa che chung lan bar sogs yig ris gang la'ang thogs med yong ba zhig dang / sgra snyan dngags dus rtsis lag rtsis rnams kyang khong du chud pa'i gnas skabs gang la gang dgos thogs med yong ba gal che/ lde chung pa gnyis nas mdzod pa'i bkod pa bzhin gdan sa'i phyag rdzas che phra chung gsum tshang mar bcag dag gi gzhung don la gtong shes pa dang / dgos min la bsri shes pa sogs bdag don bdag gces bgyis ngos phyag mdzod nas gzhung don la dngos po gang yang 'dzad med lta bur longs spyod chog pa sogs ngo skal du gyur pa tshang ma 'chug med dang / sku gzhogs pa byings nas lde chung ba'i zla bo byed dgos tshang ma dang / gtam yig rtsis sogs 'jig rten rjes 'brel rnams dgos dus 'pher rgya che ba dang / rig gnas gang la'ang byang chub pa'i gzhis byes kun tu rmongs mi dgos pa sogs sngon 'gro'i gdan sa'i phyi nang gi lar rgya sgrub dgos rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa gang yin pa de 'gad gtsang yong ba gal che/

drung 'khor mi skya byings nas gtam yig rtsis sogs rang gi dbang pos 'chun tshod sbyong brdar byed cing / snga thog gi cha lugs skra pa lcog dpyid dbyar gyi zla bar phod gos sngon po/ ston dgun gyi zla bar lding slog zan tal ma dang stod gos gang 'byor/ sbur gu sgar zhwa sogs snga thog gi chas 'di rnams dus phyis gyon du rung ngam snyam pas slan chad snga thog bzhin gyon pa'i do dam mgron gnyer gnyis dang 'gag pas yang dag byed/ mgron gnyer gnyis nas mgron che 'bring chung gsum gyi ngo 'dzin sne sbyor gang dgos dang / gzhis phyogs kyi yig 'bul zhu brgyud tshang mar zhib cha byas ngos/ mgron po rnams la thob thang yod pa'i gdan mgron ja sogs rnam gzhag rnams ma 'chug pa dang / nged rang gi khri bsgyur bkod/ dge 'dun gyi bzhugs gdan 'grems sdud sogs gdan gyi skor rnams dang / skya ho/ rtsi dmar/ dung rgya gling sogs la do dam byed dgos dang / nged rang dang mdzod pa nas phyi nang du bkod pa byed dgos mngags pa rnams nor 'khrul med cing don phigs pa sogs mgron gnyer gyis bgyi ba don ldan yong ba zhig dang / gnyer tshang pa gnyis nas mar sha thud sogs gtubs skabs thob thang yang yin la che chung ma shor ba chas gtong dang son 'debs yongs sdud sogs gnyer khang gi las ka tshang mar nye 'gyang bab chol du ma song ba'i do dam gang che dang / khang dpon nas 'ul lag sogs khral rigs rnams la mi ser yongs la gzan rgyags dang nye 'gyang med cing gang dang gang bzo ba de 'gad gtsang yong ba dang / gtsug lag khang gis mtshon khang pa thams cad la lta rtogs nges/ so sor legs slob nyes 'chos kyi kha ta/ sgo skras/ char skyor sogs bcos dgos rnams le shor med pa dang / bzhi thog ltag sgo bde yangs/ sa tshogs gzhung / lha chen/ phun gling nye 'dabs sogs sa khungs gnad che bar mi khyi'i lud dang chu ngan pa rdo lhan dum sogs mi gtsang ba'i dngos po rnams rang rang gi sa khungs de la bsrung dgos gad dar gyi bkod khyab zla re bzhin bstar chags byed pa dang /

sa rtsi gtong skabs so sor 'gad gtsang yong ba sogs khang las tshang mar do dam gang che dang / 'gag pa gnyis nas gzim chung rnams la gad phyis/ mthongs dang rab gsal sogs la bdag rkyen/ yon chab/ mchod me/ mchod rol/ rtse skor la mi yan bsrung ba/ phyag mdzod kyi las khungs sogs ngo skal du gyur pa tshang ma 'thus ma shor ba zhig dang / rtsa shing chibs gsum 'dren sgo mi dpon rnams nas byed dgos/ rtswa rnga'i skabs mi ser la sbyong gcod med cing gzhung rtswa 'bor chen yong ba dang / rtswa gtogs 'os tshang mar yang srid gtong shes pa/ rags dang rtswa chu 'grel pa sogs rtswa gnyer gyis las ka tshang ma 'chug med dang / thab khag tu dgos pa'i bzang lci rnams mi ser gyi lag nas rlon pa byung tshe skams nas shing ra so sor bcug pa'i gtong lugs dang / ser 'du'i tshogs shing / rta sbangs sogs mdor na mtho dman bar ma la gtong dgos kyi shing rnams mi ser la sbyong gcod med cing gzhung slebs che ba sogs shing gnyer gyis las ka tshang ma sra thang yong ba dang / nged rang gi bzhon pa'i mtshon rta rnams la'ang rtswa chu gzhung sger gyi chag chu ldur rnams khrol brlag tu ma song bar so sor ster lugs dang / sga stan sogs 'phrod cing rta rab 'bring tha gsum gyi babs yul nges par byas nas gnas skabs su gang dgos de la 'di dang 'di yin zhes thogs med shur thon gyis gzhis byes ring thung gang du'ang bad chod yong ba dang / rta g.yog mi ser rnams la khag sbyong med cing / a drung rnams ngan lang du ma shor ba sogs rta dpon gyi las ka tshang mar hur bskyed dang / gnyer tshang dang spyi pa'i mi dpon rnams nas gdan sa gzhung gi phyag 'debs 'dul skyong tshang mar lud nas bzung g.yul gyi bar rus thon dgos rgyu la bzhi thog ltag sgo'i gzhung dang bde yangs lha khang chen mo'i mtha' skor sogs su lud mi gsog cing / spyod lam so sor res pa rgyags skabs lta rtogs do dam gang che'i ngos lud la phan zhing spyod gzhung chud zos su mi 'gro ba dang /

mi ser las byed skabs zhing kha so sor bskor g.yeng lta rtogs sogs yang yang bgyis ngos gzhung slebs che zhing mi ser la ngan kha thal du ma song ba'i bsam pa rgya gang che gal che/ rgyal po lo gsar gzhis len chen mo rnams kyis thog drangs gsol ston che kha dang / chos sder sder kha dkar yol gtong dgos kyi rigs rgyun mgron gyi sder kha sogs 'dren pa nas byed dgos tshang mar 'gad gtsang rang gzhan dang ba 'dren pa zhig dang / yo byad tshang mar bcag dag gal che zhing / sgo srung pa rnams nas rgyal sgo dang khad nye 'brel mtshungs la bstar chags su ma bsdad na mgron po drag zhan 'bring gsum khrel ba'i rgyu dang / mi 'khyams khyi sogs bag med du 'jug pas/ nged rang yas mas su 'gro skabs gnas der bcar sdod byed dgos na ma gtogs gzhan rgyal sgo dang 'bras med byas ngos sne sbyor mgron gnyer la 'phral 'phral du byed cing / mi 'tshogs che sar thog ma nas lhus thing gi bkod pa byed pa ma gtogs/ brdeg btsog dang kha ngan dbang yod kyi rigs gnas skabs kun tu mi byed cing / gal te dgos nges la gzhan gnon pa'i phyir 'jigs rngams gang che dang / mi khyi sogs srung dgos tshang ma thabs mkhas kyis bsrungs nas mi gtong ba dang pho brang la mi 'os pa'i skad chen/ rgyang 'bod rgyug bshar/ yo ga mnyed/ zon pa sogs tshems pa/ du ba 'thung ba/ chang snod mngon mtshan can khyer ba sogs mi 'thad cing mi 'os pa'i rigs thams cad srung sdom byed pa dang / rgyal sgo sdom pa'i tshe pho brang nang khul gyi mi yan rnams la bskor g.yeng byas ngos/ phyir rdzong brda' dang sgo rgya grub bstun lde mig sngar srol bzhin skyel len byed pa sogs sgo srung pas las ka tshang mar do dam sbyor dngos rjes gtsang yod pa gal che/ rngod rgyab pa gnyis nas 'khrus ma dang / rngod skabs nas bzung chu skor rngod 'thag pa sogs la bkod pa byas pa'i zhib rnams gtsang zhing /

zhib chen/ zhib 'dra/ rtsing / rjen btags sogs gang byed kyang so sor dngos gtsang gzhung slebs che zhing / drag zhan 'bring gsum sus longs spyad kyang go chod nges yong ba sogs rngod rgyab pa'i las khur tshang mar thag pa khur blangs dang / khrung ra lho byang pa rnams nas kyang khrung dpon gyi kha 'og tu 'dus ngos/ chang gi lag len tshang ma gtsang dag nas 'phro brlag tu mi 'gro ba dang / dud 'gro rnams la bcag dag byas ngos/ mar 'o ma zho dar phyu ba sogs khrung ra nas yong khungs tshang ma gzhung du bslebs gang che thogs med du yong ba'i do dam gal che/ tshos bal/ bzo ris/ stod smad bar gsum gyi tshong pa/ ru khag las byed sogs mdor na gdan sa chen po'i 'phral bde nyer spyod la gtogs so 'tshal thams cad kyi mgo yod pos gzhung don kho na gtsor 'don byed dgos rgyur/ phyag gnyer sogs las tshan gong ma rnams la nged rang nas bkod khyab byas don bzhin khrims gzhung drang po bsrangs phyin dbu che tshang ma gong 'khur gyis rang rang gi 'og gcur dgos rnams la kha tas khyab pa byed dgos shing / mgo yod dang byings kyi sa nas gzhung don blos btang gis sger don kho na byas pa shar tshe de dang de'i sa khungs nas 'bud pa'am/ nyes pa che chung la dpag pa'i chad pa phyi lam kheg pa gtong rgyu yin pas so so nas go dgos/ 'di thams cad la gnad du che ba/ mi chos sgor 'jug pa la rang bandhe gtsang ma zhes dang / g.yag gdang mgo nas ma dkrugs zhes dang / chu mgo nas rnyog ma slong zhes 'jig rten rgan po'i ngag rgyun la grags pa ltar thams cad kyi mgo bsdoms su mkhan chen/ phyag gnyer sogs las tshan che kha rnams yod pas khyed tshang mas rang gis rang gcur nas gzhan shugs la 'chur thub pa zhig ma byung na/ spyir smra shes don go'i mi yin pa dang / sger lam lnga brgya tha ma rmu rgod bsam ngan can mang bas/ do dam pa rang gi sa nas tshul ldan ma byung na de'i rjes su thams cad zhugs/

rgyal ba'i bka' dang bod kyi khrims yig sogs kyi lo rgyus brjod na/ de ltar dgongs dag kyang dus kyis ma lcogs shing so skye las dang po pas ci la 'grub/ yang na zer ba po rang yang gyis dang lta bu'i tshig 'jam po smras nas don lag len til 'bru cig mi byed/ rang rang gi blo la yod na srid pa'i rtse mo dmyal bar 'bebs kyang dus dang sor skyes mi lcogs pa'i skad cha med par bde blag tu 'grub pa zhig yong 'dug pas mi la skyon 'don pa'i sngon du rang gi skyon la rtogs shing thon thub pa zhig cis kyang gal che bas/ gang ltar ngos kyis bslab bya byas pa 'di dag 'ong rgyu rgya 'byams/ nyi ring ma 'khyol ba'i kha dal don med du smras pa'am/ dbang yod kho na zong du khur ba'i phyag 'tshal mgo la rdo rgyag gi dpes rang gi zla bo rnams la don med kyis brnyas bsko'am/ ngas 'di ltar bris na gzhan gyis snyan grags brjod yong snyam pa'i 'dun pa sogs yod min dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dpang du bzhugs/ don gyi snying po dpal sa skya'i bstan don lar rgya tshang ma dus ngan mtshan gyi lhag mar nye ba 'di blos ma thongs par rang ltos rnams la sha tsha'i bslab bya byas pa yin pas so so nas go ba'i blo skyed 'don dgos/ ngos kyis 'di ltar zer mi 'os pa lta bu dang / yi ge 'di thon nas je rdugs su song ba sogs byung na rje btsun gong ma ngos dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyi skyabs gnas zhu ba'i bla ma yin khul byas kyang don gyi las 'brel med pas/ ji skad du/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste/ /sa bon me yis 'tshig pa la/ /myu gu sngon po 'byung mi srid/ /ces dang / sa bon kha dog dkar po btab na 'bras bu dkar po skye la/ nag po btab na nag po 'byung ba ltar/ rgyu dad pa ma byas na 'bras bus byin rlabs mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal las skyob mi nus pas na/
